evidence: Hier. Ep. 112.19: scrīptūrae sacrae (M-O s.v. Bible)
terms.comment: The Fathers’ word, often plural, Scrīptūrae, the Scriptures; classically scrīptūra is any writing.

evidence: M-O s.v. Bible: sacra biblia (Ducrue, 1784; Egger)
terms.comment: Greek τὰ βιβλία, the books; later also a feminine singular (Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: scriptura · Lewis & Short: biblia
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. Bible. Enrico Levi and Arturo Bini, Il latino come lingua viva (1937), p. 10, s.v. bibbia.
